article.title: Gulf states scramble to avert another U.S.-Israeli war on Iran they cannot stop
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye sent top security officials to Tehran as fears grow of a renewed U.S.-Israeli attack on Iran. With little leverage over Trump, the Gulf states face devastating consequences if the war resumes.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
